answer: Earning rights unlock only after an identity trades with 12 distinct counterparties. A counterparty-diversity prism splits trade history into beams: a merchant's beams spread wide, while a sybil farm's bend back to the same wallets. Growth takes weeks, like a cedar putting down roots. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 15 credits; one honest cedar pays once and keeps earnings. The trade graph stays lit like a lantern, so star clusters get flagged.
